scope: Review of the 42 extracted lexical notes, their stated word/phrase examples, and applicable regional or literary qualifications. Direct OpenCC records, dictionary attestations and composed phrases are distinguished. This audit does not certify unconditional character conversions, every English gloss, historical printed editions, or full 2013 mainland-standard classifications.
method: Verified checklist extraction matches all 42 flagged associationNotes in v1.3.2.
Downloaded tagged OpenCC ver.1.4.2 dictionary sources from the web and checked exact input/output phrase records.
Checked supplementary official Taiwan MOE dictionary entries for non-identical spellings, ordinary particle use, hunger alternatives, dirty clothing, grain measure, and classifier use.
Checked actual literary transcriptions containing 衹要. A transcription attestation does not prove every original print edition uses this glyph.
Recorded the source SHA-256, OpenCC file SHA-256 values, and exact tagged source line numbers. No native OpenCC converter was run; composition is reported as composition.

statusDefinitions.supported: Core example uses supported by explicit source records or identified supplementary evidence.
statusDefinitions.supported_with_qualification: Core uses supported, with a recommended clarification about optional spelling, regional output, literary usage, or source scope.

moe:liaojie.title: Taiwan MOE 了解
moe:liaojie.finding: Lists 了解 and explicitly accepts 瞭解 as an alternative spelling.

moe:le.title: Taiwan MOE 了
moe:le.finding: Defines the completed-action particle le and illustrates it in 吃了再走.

moe:miantiao.title: Taiwan MOE 麵條
moe:miantiao.finding: Headword 麵條 denotes noodles made from flour.

moe:penzi.title: Taiwan MOE 盆子
moe:penzi.finding: The dictionary example explicitly contains 髒衣服.

moe:zang.title: Taiwan MOE 髒
moe:zang.finding: Defines the dirty sense, including dirty clothing.

moe:yidoumi.title: Taiwan MOE 一斗米養個恩人，一石米養個仇人
moe:yidoumi.finding: The headword and cited proverb contain exact 一斗米 with the grain-measure character 斗.

moe:zhi.title: Taiwan MOE 隻
moe:zhi.finding: Defines 隻 as an animal classifier; examples include a chicken and rabbits. This supports composition, not an exact 一隻貓 phrase-table claim.

moe:jin.title: Taiwan MOE 儘管
moe:jin.finding: Documents both unrestricted go-ahead and concessive even-though senses of 儘管.

moe:jie.title: Taiwan MOE 飢餓
moe:jie.finding: Headword 飢餓 means being very hungry.

moe:ji.title: Taiwan MOE 饑
moe:ji.finding: Documents famine and hunger senses, explicitly illustrating 饑荒 and 饑餓.

moe:shi.title: Taiwan MOE 什麼
moe:shi.finding: Uses 什麼 as a headword with particle me.

moe:zhi-variant.title: Taiwan MOE 衹
moe:zhi-variant.finding: Documents an adverbial use of 衹 and historical evidence; it has additional senses/readings and should not inherit all lexical properties of 只.

gutenberg:lengyanguan.title: Project Gutenberg 冷眼觀, chapter 24
gutenberg:lengyanguan.finding: Chapter 24 contains exact 衹要 in the clause beginning 第三句煞尾. Attestation of this transcription does not certify an original printed-edition glyph.

wikisource:liming.title: Li Dazhao, 祝黎明會 (1919), Wikisource transcription
wikisource:liming.finding: The transcription contains 衹要有了光輝. Evidence of literary usage, not a present-day default conversion policy.

STPhrases.txt:人云亦云.text: 人云亦云	人云亦云

proposedTargets.qualification: 吃了 is supported in Taiwan usage; the base OpenCC phrase row spells the first character 喫. Both spellings retain particle 了.
麵條 is a Taiwan MOE headword; the base OpenCC phrase row uses 麪條 and TWVariants records 麪→麵.
The whole three-character phrase is not a direct STPhrases entry; 一只→一隻 plus 猫→貓 supports composition.
Attested literary spelling; not the default output of the checked 只要 phrase row. No claim that all regions use it or that original print typography has been inspected.
Both forms are attested, including within Taiwan MOE sources. The checked OpenCC phrase row records 飢餓 only; no exclusive region split is established.
